text: おれ　おかあさんに　たのんで　たんパンに　「タケシ」って　ししゅうを　してもらったよ！

structure.jp: おれ　おかあさんに　たのんで
たんパンに　「タケシ」って
ししゅうを　してもらったよ！

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: てもらう after a verb says someone does that thing for you. ししゅうを してもらった = 'I had her embroider it for me'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending (here で) joins this action to the next one, like 'and'. おかあさんに たのんで = 'I asked my mom, and'.

patterns.name: 〜って (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and shows the exact words that were written. 「タケシ」って ししゅう = 'embroidery that says "Brock"'.
